arithmetic.phase_lift_formula: phi(u,v)=q(u)+q(v)-q(u+v)+2*u^T*C*v mod 4; C_ii=q(e_i), C_ij=omega(e_i,e_j) for i>j, C_ij=0 for i<j
arithmetic.lp: exact Fraction primal simplex plus dual certificate

power_support_semantics: power_supports[k] is the exact nonzero Pauli-label support of the symbolic homogeneous polynomial H^k; T_L is their union for k=0..7
character_equation_semantics: A[v,ell]=(-1)^(ell dot v), rhs[v]=(-1)^q(v), for v in T_L and ell in W*
character_witness_semantics: restricted_character_witnesses are ell in W*; for realizable rank-2/rank-4 forms every such ell has an ambient Pauli extension, while the separate ambient_pauli_witnesses_inside_W field lists only witnesses represented inside W
physical_scope: A proper four-dimensional subspace of the nondegenerate three-qubit Pauli symplectic space has restricted rank 2 or 4; rank 0 cases are retained as abstract counterexamples but are not physical three-qubit embeddings

equivalence.group: (GL(2,2) x GL(2,2)) semidirect C2 acting on r tensor c

classification_claim.refined_statement: The proposed classification fails for the rank-0 zero form, which cannot be the restriction of the three-qubit nondegenerate symplectic form to a proper four-dimensional grid span. It holds for every enumerated rank-2 or rank-4 case.
